summary: Beam Global filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, announcing its 2026 annual meeting for December 17, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. Pacific Time at its San Diego headquarters. The record date is October 19, 2026. Because the meeting is more than 30 days after the 2025 annual meeting anniversary, the prior proxy deadline no longer applies. Stockholder proposals under Rule 14a-8 are due by October 26, 2026; Rule 14a-19 notices for dissident director nominations are due October 25, 2026. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation.
